subject: A007
task_naming: the program primitive and its object, verb_object (unscrew + bottle cap)
task_description: Unscrew the cap of the large black and yellow striped bottle.
window_unit: OakInk2 mocap frame ids (120 Hz), end exclusive

cap.name: large black and yellow striped bottle cap

body.name: large black and yellow striped bottle body

conventions.hands: axis 1 of every (T, 2, ...) array: 0 = left, 1 = right
conventions.joints: 21: 0 wrist; thumb 1-4, index 5-8, middle 9-12, ring 13-16, pinky 17-20, base to tip
conventions.world: OakInk2's world frame (metres, +y up, from its calibrated cameras and mocap) rotated +90 deg about x so that +z is up: p = R_up p_oakink2 (world_from_oakink2_world); the table top is at z = 0 (the lowest vertex of the bottle body, from its recorded pose and mesh, is at z = 0.5 mm)
conventions.camera: OpenCV: x right, y down, z forward; cam = R^T (world - t) with head_pose_world = [R t; 0 1]
conventions.head_pose_world: camera-to-world 4x4 (the inverse of OakInk2's egocentric cam_extr, moved into the output world)
conventions.timestamps: (mocap frame id - first mocap frame id) / 120 s: the camera frames are mostly every 4th mocap frame but not always, so the spacing is 2 to 6 mocap frames; the mp4 files play at a constant 30 fps
conventions.quaternion: wrist_quat_world is [qw, qx, qy, qz]: the rotation of OakInk2's MANO root (global orient), moved into the output world; MANO's root axes, not a tracker wrist frame
conventions.skeleton: OakInk2's MANO parameters evaluated with the MANO model as its toolkit does (manotorch: left model unchanged, flat hand mean, wrist moved to the stored translation, fingertips at vertices 745, 317, 444 (445 left), 556, 673)
conventions.in_view: hand labelled, wrist more than 5 cm in front of the camera and its pixel inside the image
conventions.skeleton_px: NaN where the joint is at or behind the camera (z <= 5 cm)
conventions.objects: objects.npz pose_world (T, P, 4, 4): mesh frame -> output world for part P of objects.npz 'part'; the meshes in objects/<obj_id>/ are OakInk2's object_repair models (metres), byte for byte
conventions.annotations: OakInk2's program segment(s) overlapping the window: start_idx inclusive, end_idx exclusive, in clip frames; mocap_frames are the dataset's own (inclusive) frame ids

label_source: OakInk2's shipped annotation: MANO hands and object poses from its multi-view mocap and RGB-D rig, not estimates from the egocentric video

annotations.text: Unscrew the cap of the large black and yellow striped bottle.
annotations.right_hand: unscrew large black and yellow striped bottle cap
annotations.left_hand: hold large black and yellow striped bottle body
